narrative.overview: Hypatia frames every stage of a League of Legends match as a compact motorsport timing wall. Unhurried carbon panels establish a calm backdrop while pure inverted ivory plates and crisp amber signals mark immediate action moments.
keyCharacteristics: Dark carbon Night (default) and warm drafting-paper Day printings meeting WCAG AA contrast.
Barlow Condensed timing numerals, Overpass UI copy, and Overpass Mono telemetry streams.
Semantic separation between live source green, signal amber, Blue/Red teams, and Summoner's Rift lane inks.
Strict 11px minimum functional typography floor across desktop and mobile.

rules.name: The Signal Restraint Rule
rules.body: Pit-Wall Amber never appears as passive decoration; it marks active navigation, active phase milestones, or player turns/CTAs.

rules.name: The Lane-Team Separation Rule
rules.body: Lane inks draw only tracks and roundels while Team Blue/Red own champions, objectives, towers, and bans.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: Every interactive label, timestamp, and badge stays at 11px or larger across Slint and HTML.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section cards and plates lead with their headline first; supporting details follow beside or below.

rules.name: The Full-Perimeter 1px Rule
rules.body: Highlighted rows and alerts use soft surface tints and full 1px perimeter borders instead of thick side stripes.

dos: Do highlight active picks, ready checks, and selected tabs with signal-soft fills and 1px full-perimeter borders.
Do format countdowns, HTTP paths, ports, and KDA values in Overpass Mono with tabular figures.
Do maintain >= 11px font sizes and bundle font assets locally offline.
donts: Don't place miniature eyebrows above headlines or section titles.
Don't use >1px border-left/right accent stripes on cards, rows, or alerts.
Don't prefix tabs with ordinal numbers (1 · / 2 ·) or replace 2px SVG icons with Unicode glyphs.
